prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE finished standalone PNG game asset for Master of Orion — Reborn. Filename: race-meklar-audience.png. Requested dimensions 1920x1080, 16:9. Input image: approved race leader portrait, visual reference for original species design, believable materials, costume identity and lighting.
Race lore and art direction:
9 · Meklar — Meklon — cold cyan
Game role: automated industry. Strengths: factories run extra per colonist; cheap computing. Weakness: poor planetologists. Efficient assembly lines; "least predictable councils".
Body & dress: cyborgs — a humanoid face half organic, half titanium; one glowing lens eye, panelled skull, cables into the collar, exoskeleton shoulder rigs, extra mechanical arms or tool-limbs. Severe black coats over their machinery, thin cyan piping, serial-number plates instead of insignia.
Surroundings: colossal automated foundries: assembly arms in constant motion, molten-metal glow and blue-white arc light, gantries, conveyor rivers, status screens everywhere, oil-sheen floors, ordered noise. Council halls are bare steel rooms with rows of terminals.
Personality: precise, clinical, occasionally erratic when "logic" disagrees with a vote. Moods: efficient neutral → cold impatience → glitch-like flicker of strain.
Hooks: a spare limb on a workbench, maintenance staff of drones, a visible repair seam being welded.
Asset purpose: Diplomacy audience background. Create an imposing seat of power: audience hall, throne-office or war room derived from the race surroundings, with spatial depth and homeworld atmosphere.
Composition: No foreground characters: the game composites its existing leader portrait separately. Keep left 45% and bottom 30% dark and calm; architecture, windows, light and visual interest at centre-right.
Visual treatment: photorealistic cinematic hard sci-fi concept still, serious prestige drama, worn lived-in industrial materials, 85mm portrait lens language where appropriate, strong key from left, restrained race-colored rim, deep shadows, subtle film grain, muted filmic grade. Match reference realism and species identity. ONE dominant race accent color. No text, captions, readable glyphs or equations, numbers, watermark, logos, borders, interface, real-world flags or symbols. Small non-text original costume insignia from reference may remain. Avoid cartoon, anime, cel shading, toy, plastic, waxy skin, cute mascot, oversized eyes, rainbow saturation, fantasy armor, medieval costume, malformed hands or duplicated limbs. Full frame is one coherent scene, never a collage.
